description: Elastic Security SIEM alert rules — Multi-Stage Lateral Movement Chain Detection

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Initial Access Followed by Internal Reconnaissance
rules.description: Detects the chain of initial compromise followed by internal network reconnaissance within a short timeframe

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Credential Dumping Followed by Lateral Movement
rules.description: Detects credential dumping activity followed by lateral movement to other systems using harvested credentials

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Exploitation Followed by Persistence Installation
rules.description: Detects exploitation of a vulnerability followed by installation of persistent access mechanisms

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Phishing Followed by Account Compromise
rules.description: Detects phishing email delivery followed by successful authentication from unusual locations using compromised credentials

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Privilege Escalation Followed by Data Access
rules.description: Detects privilege escalation followed by access to sensitive data repositories within a short timeframe

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Worm Propagation Pattern
rules.description: Detects self-propagating worm behavior characterized by sequential compromise and lateral spread across multiple hosts
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND _marker:worm_propagation_pattern AND compromised_hosts:>3 AND time_window:"1h"

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Supply Chain Compromise Followed by Internal Pivot
rules.description: Detects supply chain compromise indicators followed by internal network pivoting activity

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Web Shell Upload Followed by Command Execution
rules.description: Detects web shell upload followed by command execution from the web server process

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Scheduled Task Creation Followed by Execution
rules.description: Detects creation of scheduled tasks on remote systems followed by execution indicating lateral movement persistence

rules.name: Lateral Chain — DNS Tunneling for Data Exfiltration
rules.description: Detects DNS tunneling activity followed by data exfiltration through encoded DNS queries
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND dns.question.name:* AND _marker:dns_tunnel_followed_by_exfil AND time_window:"6h"

rules.name: Lateral Chain — LLMNR/NBT-NS Poisoning Followed by SMB Relay
rules.description: Detects LLMNR/NBT-NS poisoning followed by SMB relay attacks enabling lateral movement across the network

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Service Account Compromise Followed by Domain Admin
rules.description: Detects compromise of a service account followed by escalation to domain admin privileges

rules.name: Lateral Chain — PowerShell Download Followed by Execution
rules.description: Detects PowerShell download cradles followed by execution of downloaded payloads indicating lateral movement

rules.name: Lateral Chain — VPN Compromise Followed by Internal Pivot
rules.description: Detects VPN credential compromise followed by lateral movement from the VPN entry point into the internal network

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Cloud Instance Metadata Followed by Lateral Movement
rules.description: Detects cloud instance metadata service access followed by lateral movement using harvested credentials

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Kerberoasting Followed by Ticket-Based Lateral Movement
rules.description: Detects Kerberoasting attack followed by use of cracked service tickets for lateral movement across the domain

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Living-off-the-Land Tool Chain
rules.description: Detects chains of legitimate system tools used in sequence for lateral movement (e.g., cmd.exe→wmic.exe→powershell.exe)
rules.query: event.category:"process" AND _marker:lotl_chain_detected AND process.chain:>2 AND time_window:"30m"

rules.name: Lateral Chain — SSH Key Theft Followed by Remote Access
rules.description: Detects SSH key theft followed by unauthorized remote access using those keys to move laterally

rules.name: Lateral Chain — DCOM Lateral Movement After Credential Harvest
rules.description: Detects credential harvesting followed by DCOM-based lateral movement to remote systems

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Zero-Day Exploit Followed by Rapid Spread
rules.description: Detects exploitation of unknown vulnerabilities followed by rapid lateral spread consistent with zero-day worm behavior
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND _marker:zero_day_exploit_followed_by_spread AND compromised_hosts:>5 AND time_window:"4h"

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Ransomware Lateral Movement Pattern
rules.description: Detects ransomware-style lateral movement pattern: initial access → credential theft → SMB/WMI spread → file encryption
rules.query: event.category:* AND _marker:ransomware_lateral_chain AND compromised_hosts:>2 AND time_window:"6h"

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Cloud API Key Compromise Followed by Resource Access
rules.description: Detects cloud API key compromise followed by unauthorized access to cloud resources for lateral movement

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Container Escape Followed by Host Compromise
rules.description: Detects container escape followed by host system compromise and lateral movement to other containers or hosts

rules.name: Lateral Chain — Watering Hole Followed by Credential Harvest
rules.description: Detects watering hole compromise followed by credential harvesting from compromised visitors

rules.name: Lateral Chain — APT Persistence Chain Detection
rules.description: Detects advanced persistent threat multi-stage persistence chains: initial access → persistence → privilege escalation → lateral movement → exfiltration
rules.query: event.category:* AND _marker:apt_full_chain_detected AND stages_detected:>3 AND time_window:"168h"
